Folder convention for easy replacement:

- `weddings/01.webp`, `weddings/02.webp`, ...
- `bar-mitzvah/01.webp`, `bar-mitzvah/02.webp`, ...
- `brit/01.webp`, `brit/02.webp`, ...

If you replace an image with a new file using the same folder and filename, the website updates automatically without code changes.
